text:
alex: Quick follow-up from last night — the authz token validation failure caused ~20m errors. We need a compact action tracker: owners, deadlines, and whether this maps to the same recurring pattern we saw in Jan/Mar. Who can own each item?

mira: I can own the token validation fixes (root cause was cached public key expiry + missing fallback). Plan: patch verifier to refresh on cache miss and add metrics. Target EOD Thu.

sam: I'll take permissions mapping audit — the incident exposed a stale role mapping used by the router. I'll run a one-off audit across environments and push a policy to reject deprecated roles by next Tue.

julia: Ops: can you confirm audit log coverage for the affected endpoints? We need to ensure we capture token header + decision audit.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: staging verifier patch deployed (canary 10%). Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/incident/1850001234 :warning:

kevin: I checked logs — we had 3 identical failure clusters at 03:12, 03:38, 03:55 UTC. Looks like the fallback key rotation didn't kick in for ~40m window. I'm flagging this as a recurring pattern (token key refresh misses).

alex: Good catch, kevin. Add automated alert when verifier cache hit ratio drops > 95% for 5m. Who picks that up?

mira: I will add the alert and a dashboard row. Will include a runbook note: if cache hit drops, trigger immediate cache invalidation + rollout to force fetch. ETA: today 18:00 UTC.

sam: For the audit we should add a simple CI check: when role mappings change, require signed approval. I'll sketch a PR template. ETA Wed.

julia: Ops — can you confirm whether our audit logs currently contain token raw headers? If not, we should add an opt-in to include redacted token metadata. Privacy guardrails needed.

ops-bot: security-check: current audit pipeline stores request metadata and decision events. It does NOT persist raw Authorization header. We can add a redacted header field (first 8 chars + hash). Proposed change tracked: https://git.internal/rf/issues/427

kevin: Also recommend we schedule a quarterly secrets rotation validation drill. Not just rotate, but validate fallback behavior and renewal. I can run the first drill next month.

alex: OK items recap (for tracking):
- mira: verifier cache refresh + fallback logic + alert (ETA today 18:00 UTC)
- sam: role-mapping audit + CI approval gate (ETA Wed)
- julia/ops: confirm audit log changes + redacted header plan (ops link above)
- kevin: run secrets-rotation validation drill (ETA next month)

mira: I'll post a small PR and link it here when ready.

sam: Adding owners to the incident board now.

julia: Let's have a 30m sync tomorrow to check progress and decide whether to roll the verifier change to prod. Prefer 14:00 UTC.

alex: 14:00 works for me. If anything blocks earlier, DM. Thanks all :thumbsup:
